pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.summary: How MS Enterprise collects, handles, and protects client information.
pages.content:
## Privacy Policy

At MS Enterprise, we respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding personal information you provide when using our website and services.

### Information We Collect
When you submit an inquiry or interact with our services, we may collect your name, email address, phone number, and project requirements. We collect this data exclusively to respond to your inquiries and deliver our services.

### How We Use Your Information
Your details are used solely for project communication, proposal generation, service fulfillment, and technical support. We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.

### Data Security
We implement standard technical measures to protect submitted information against unauthorized access, disclosure, or loss. All admin access is protected by encrypted authentication.

### Contact Us
If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us via our official email at contact@msenterprise.com.
pages.metaDescription: Read the privacy policy of MS Enterprise. Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.summary: Terms and conditions governing web development, Meta services, and ecommerce VA engagements.
pages.content:
## Terms of Service

These Terms of Service govern the professional relationship between MS Enterprise and our clients.

### 1. Scope of Work
All services, including web development, Meta organic growth, and ecommerce virtual assistant management, are delivered based on agreed project specifications and written confirmations.

### 2. Client Responsibilities
Clients agree to provide necessary assets, access credentials, and timely feedback needed for the completion of their project.

### 3. Support and Maintenance
Web development projects receive lifetime live support for bugs and technical faults within the original delivery scope. Additional feature requests or third-party platform changes may be subject to our low monthly maintenance agreements.

### 4. Honest Commitment and Unforeseen Delays
We take our commitments seriously. If a delay occurs because of an unavoidable natural emergency or extreme situation, we will notify the client immediately, provide an honest explanation, and offer reasonable compensation.
pages.metaDescription: Review the terms and conditions for working with MS Enterprise across web development, Meta, and VA services.

pages.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy
pages.summary: Clear guidelines regarding cancellations, project milestones, and refund conditions.
pages.content:
## Refund and Cancellation Policy

MS Enterprise believes in fair, transparent business practices.

### Project Milestones
For custom website projects, work is divided into clear milestones (e.g., discovery, design review, development, and deployment). If a cancellation is requested prior to the commencement of development, advance payments for unstarted stages are refunded promptly.

### Virtual Assistant and Monthly Services
Virtual assistant and monthly Meta services operate on a monthly billing cycle. You may cancel at any time before your next billing cycle begins with zero cancellation penalty.

### Resolution and Fair Adjustment
If you are dissatisfied with any stage of our work, we work directly with you to resolve the matter or offer a mutually fair adjustment. If an unavoidable situation on our end delays your work, we provide appropriate service credit or compensation.

faqs.question: What does "Lifetime Live Support" include for custom websites?
faqs.answer: Lifetime live support means you can always contact our technical team if your delivered website experiences unexpected technical issues, server misconfigurations, or operational questions related to the delivered code. We troubleshoot and resolve code bugs introduced under the original scope at no extra charge.

faqs.question: How do you handle website redesigns?
faqs.answer: We analyze your existing website alongside top competitor platforms in your industry. We identify what works effectively, diagnose why visitors drop off, and reconstruct the website with modern code, improved navigation, and faster loading speeds according to your satisfaction.

faqs.question: How do you generate audience traffic for Meta (Facebook) pages?
faqs.answer: We generate genuine audience traffic using organic strategies tailored to your target countries. We do not use fake bot accounts or artificial engagement. We align content strategy, relevant community engagement, and distribution to build a real audience.

faqs.question: What platforms can your Ecommerce Virtual Assistants handle?
faqs.answer: Our virtual assistants operate across any platform your business uses, including Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon Seller Central, eBay, BigCommerce, or custom administrative dashboards. We handle product listings, inventory sync, order fulfillment, and customer inquiries.

faqs.question: What is your policy if an unexpected delay occurs?
faqs.answer: Authenticity is our core rule. If an unavoidable emergency or severe natural situation causes a delay in your project or VA schedule, we immediately inform you, apologize openly, and provide proportional compensation such as extra service hours or bill adjustments.

faqs.question: What are your monthly maintenance charges for websites?
faqs.answer: We keep our monthly maintenance charges very low. It covers server uptime monitoring, security patches, library updates, and regular database backups so your website remains fast and stable without unexpected expenses.
